admin.rule.title.description: Title of the page of one rule.

admin.rule.back.description: Link from the page of a rule, or of a new one, back to the list of rules.

admin.rule.facts.description: Heading of the region of a rule's page with its text, hint, state and dates.

admin.rule.state.description: Term of whether a rule is in effect or retired, on its page.

admin.rule.created_at.description: Term of when a rule was added, on its page.

admin.rule.no_hint.description: Value of the hint of a rule that has none, on its page.

admin.rule.retire.title.description: Heading of the region of a rule's page that retires it.
